anomalies.message: CPU load average is high across all time intervals, indicating potential over-utilization or bottleneck.
AI system is not generating any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, which suggests it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows no active trades or profit/loss activity, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system instability.
Review and potentially restart or reconfigure the AI component to ensure it is actively learning and generating opportunities.
Evaluate the trading strategies and market conditions to ensure they are aligned and functioning as expected.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the root cause.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and affect the performance of the trading platform.

recommendations.action: Verify the operational status of the AI system and ensure it is configured correctly to perform learning cycles and generate trading opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: The AI system is crucial for generating trading opportunities and improving trading strategies.

recommendations.action: Analyze the trading environment and strategies to determine why there are no active trades or profit/loss activities.
recommendations.rationale: Understanding the lack of trading activity is important to ensure the platform is operating effectively.
